'''Kepitenochan''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that housed a structure known as [[Government Tree]].

==Description==
Kepitenochan was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It sat on the forest floor,<ref name="SW:GB" /> whereas most Wookiee cities were placed up in the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> The city had a [[Command center]] and a number of [[Prefab shelter]]s, along with military buildings. A [[Government Tree]] was constructed in the city.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
[[File:Kepitenochan_Government_Tree.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Han Solo and Chewbacca after rebuilding the Government Tree in Kepitenochan.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] Kepitenochan endured a brutal attack during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|subjugation]] of Kashyyyk,<ref name="DV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> with it being known that [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|Incinerator stormtroopers]] were involved in the attack.<ref name="IHACG">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, during the early days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], it was [[Devastation of Kashyyyk|burned down]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Darcc]] in an attempt to reign in the Wookiees. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Weebacca]] [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|reoccupied]] the city with Wookiee [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] they had freed and rebuilt the Government Tree to serve as a rallying point. They endured attacks emanating from the Imperial's nearby [[Imperial River Base|River Base]], but even as soon as construction started survivors started returning.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kepitenochan was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared during a Chewbacca campaign mission. The mission and thus Kepitenochan was also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
